The finite quotient bound is quantified only at positive population sizes; asymptotic assertions disregard the initial zero index.

Adds finiteness of the positive-probability assignment support. The feasible assignment type remains arbitrary and may contain infinitely many zero-mass assignments; no stability, independence or global outcome bound is assumed. All infinite-positive-support designs are excluded, including those with existing targeted moments. Retains the supported-atom exposure-probability formula, finite targeted absolute moments, conditional exposure-mean equalities, AEPO averaging, unit conditional-mean contrasts, and both AEED identities.
